results.title: JJ Redick Breaks Silence on Bronny James’ Demotion as the Lakers Star Goes Off on G-League Return
results.description: Less than a month ago, the Lakers cut Dalton Knecht and kept Bronny James on the roster. On Thursday, they sent James to the G League after just 12 minutes of play through nine games. JJ Redick has now explained the thinking, and he framed it as a plan rather than a punishment. “I mean […] The post JJ Redick Breaks Silence on Bronny James’ Demotion as the Lakers Star Goes Off on G-League Return appeared first on EssentiallySports.
